seg.notes: The Q4-22 8-K EX-99.1 press release contains only narrative pages (no financial appendices); all tables (IS, segment, backlog, product lines, Reported→Adjusted, EBITDA, sales bridge) were taken from the Appendix slides of the same 8-K's EX-99.2 earnings deck. corp_op −84 published in 10-K segment note. 10-K intersegment sales: Freight 51, Transit 31 (eliminated).

ngaap.guidance: 2023 (initiated Feb-15-2023): sales $8.7-9.0B; adjusted diluted EPS $5.15-5.55; operating cash flow conversion >90%; deck: tax rate ~25.5%, capex ~2% of sales, adjusted operating margin up. $750M buyback reauthorized; quarterly dividend +13% to $0.17. Integration 2.0: $135-165M restructuring charges expected through 2024, $75-90M savings by 2025.
ngaap.notes: Adjusted results (2022 definition) exclude restructuring & transaction costs (one combined line; recorded in items.restructuring) and ALL non-cash intangible amortization expense (add-back in place since before 2021). The foreign-exchange gain/loss adjustment used through Q4-2021 was dropped in 2022. Adjusted EBITDA excludes restructuring & transaction costs only. From Q4-22 the line is labelled 'Restructuring costs' (Integration 2.0). The Q4-22 8-K EX-99.1 press release contains only narrative pages (no financial appendices); all tables (IS, segment, backlog, product lines, Reported→Adjusted, EBITDA, sales bridge) were taken from the Appendix slides of the same 8-K's EX-99.2 earnings deck. EBITDA recon adds back restructuring of $29m (Q4) / $49m (FY) vs $32m / $52m in the adjusted-results table (difference presumably restructuring-related D&A already in D&A — not explained in source). Operating cash flow conversion 93%.
